verdict.rationale: Digits claims customizable financial statements and reports, has a help article on creating a custom report, and advertises dimensional reporting, but only on Core and Pro plans. The evidence never names class, location, or tag dimensions. It also never shows how reports are filtered or grouped by them, so the support is only implied by marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of class/location/tag dimensions, a description of filter and group-by mechanics in custom reports, hands-on or independent corroboration, and availability on all tiers.
